basis: stock at the end of the month
description: M4: monthly amounts outstanding of M4 (monetary financial institutions' sterling M4 liabilities to the private sector), Bank of England
method: Bank of England IADB CSV, one plain curl request (no retry); the response is archived unchanged under _raw/
notes: M4ex (the Bank's preferred measure) is not used: its IADB code is unconfirmed.
refresh: history from 2015-01 re-downloaded every run; a failed fetch keeps the previous file
